description: This header file defines prefetch functions for memory optimization, including functions for prefetching data into cache with different locality hints, and includes platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: PrefetchToLocalCache
methods.description: Prefetches data into the L1 cache with high temporal locality.

methods.name: PrefetchToLocalCacheNta
methods.description: Prefetches data into the cache with non-temporal (short-term) locality.

methods.name: PrefetchToLocalCacheForWrite
methods.description: Prefetches data with intent to modify, potentially invalidating cache lines.
